name: Aranjuez (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Aranjuez (a cross of Saint James on white and a palace above waves on red, with a scroll reading Real Sitio y Villa de Aranjuez).
history: The municipal flag of Aranjuez was approved officially on 20 May 1999; the arms were regulated by the Boletín Oficial de la Comunidad de Madrid of 14 July 2009, with a knotted golden ribbon bearing the legend Real Sitio y Villa de Aranjuez.
